listing.name: Dark QOL
listing.summary: Adds quality-of-life features including colony buildings like a private arsenal and reverse engineering hub, faction system intel menus, and a command to spawn gates.
listing.aiSummary: Adds quality-of-life features including colony buildings like a private arsenal and reverse engineering hub, faction system intel menus, and a command to spawn gates.

description:
Dark QOL

Current Version:

2.40

Compatibility:

Starsector 0.97a-RC11

Dependencies:

None

Repo:

Link here

Download:

Download here

Colony Buildings:

Colony Buildings

Private Arsenal A secure facility that grants access to all weapons and fighter wings discovered by the player's faction. Available only on player-owned colonies, it provides a private arms market without affecting the local economy.

This industry unlocks a special submarket where you can buy all the weapons and fighters you have unlocked.

[close]

Reverse Engineering Hub A high-tech facility dedicated to analyzing and reproducing advanced technology through reverse engineering. By deconstructing recovered items, it allows for the creation of blueprints to expand your faction's capabilities.

Place items into the storage to reverse engineer them.

Once you have achieved 100% progress, you will receive a blueprint.

Tier 1:

Only weapons are allowed.

Tier 2:

Only weapons and fighter wings are allowed.

Tier 3:

Weapons, fighter wings, and ships are allowed.

Choose in priority the item you don t have discovered yet.

Mechanic inspired by the Engineer Hub from Industrial Evolution (

link

).

[close]

Rift Maker A groundbreaking megastructure that generates a stable spatial gateway around the planet, enabling instant travel to distant star systems.

The RiftMaker creates a gate that gravitates around the planet, allowing fleets and trade convoys to bypass hyperspace entirely.

[close]

[close]

Intel Menus:

Intel Menus

Faction Systems

The Faction Systems feature allows you to view all the systems where the selected faction owns planets. Additionally, it enables zooming in on these systems and sorting them based on their proximity to the player's fleet.

[close]

[close]

Commands:

Dark_spawnGateCommand: `

Dark_spawnGate

`

Spawn a gate at the player’s position, affected by the closest star or planet.

[close]

Installation

Download the mod from this link.  
 Extract the archive into the `Starsector/mods` folder.  Enable the mod in the game launcher.

Compatibility & Balance

- Compatible with other economy and industry mods.

- Balanced to provide a useful feature without breaking the game’s economy.

Feedback & Suggestions

Let me know your thoughts! Feel free to share suggestions or report any issues in this thread.

Thanks

Special thanks to the entire Starsector community for helping me understand and fix various bugs during the creation of this mod.

My very first mod: feel free to suggest things or report bugs.

The private arsenal provides access to all unlocked weapons and fighters. The reverse engineering hub allows creating blueprints by deconstructing items.
